:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.1, Chap 8.4.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/infoCode.xml).
:::

`infoCode` is a part of the data module code (DMC): the information code that states what type of information a data module holds. The value is three alphanumeric characters. It is written together with [`infoCodeVariant`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/info-code-variant/).

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 2 elements carry this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dmCode` | 28 | Required |
| `updateCode` | 1 | Required |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided in two steps: by the XML schema and by BREX (Business Rules Exchange).

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `infoCodeAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The pattern is `[A-Z0-9]{3}` |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00179) | Allows 13 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//updateIdent/updateCode/@infoCode`. The rule applies to all schemas |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00180) | Allows 593 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//dmIdent/dmCode/@infoCode`. The rule applies to all schemas |

BREX-S1-00179 allows the following values and defines how a lower-level BREX can tailor each of them.

| Value | `valueForm` | `valueTailoring` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `00E` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00F` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00G` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00H` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00J` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00K` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00L` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00M` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00N` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `00X` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `0A1` to `0A2` | `single` | `restrictable` |
| `012` | `single` | `restrictable` |

BREX-S1-00180 has 593 values, so this page does not list them. Look up the values and their meaning with `lookup_value` of [s1000d-brex-mcp](/s1000d-stack/mcp/brex-mcp/) or in the default BREX.

## Meaning of the values

The list of information codes is in Chap 8.4.1 of the specification. The default BREX defines 593 values for the `infoCode` of a data module and 13 values for the `infoCode` of a data update file. This page lists only the values that appear in other rules.

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `022` | BREX data module |
| `024` | Business rules document |
| `040` | Description |

## Related rules

- A BREX data module has `infoCode` `022` and [`itemLocationCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/item-location-code/) `D` (BREX-S1-00268 of the default BREX).
- A business rules document data module has `infoCode` `024` and `itemLocationCode` `D` (BREX-S1-00265).

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Look up the meaning of a value | [`lookup_value`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/brex/lookup-value/) (`infoCode` in `target`, the value to check in `value`) |
| Filter by information code | `filter.infoCode` of [`list_data_modules`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/list-data-modules/) |
| Decide it when a data module is created | `allocation.rules.infoCodeByKind` of [`build_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/build-data-module/). There is no default value. If it is omitted, the tool returns `input-error` |

The project decides which information code to use. The tools do not choose an information code.
